d.ko: A new chapter begins with the arrival of the catgirl, Fraise! She seeks advice from his little sister, Shigure and while Fraise feels the relationship between siblings is most important, Shigure priorities the happiness of her catgirls. This sets the stage in the battle between catgirl and girl!

d.zh:
草莓被托付给了嘉祥之后，她渐渐对同样心藏爱意的时雨敞开了心扉。
草莓主张兄妹间的关系更重要，时雨则是认为猫娘的幸福高于一切。
想让彼此的恋情先实现——一只猫娘和一个女孩的攻防战就此开始！
